title: विंशतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Ashtavakra agrees and goes north, where Kubera honours him and he sees the splendours of Kailasa and the Himalaya. He then comes to a lovely hermitage of gold and gems, where an old woman welcomes him.
summary.kn: ಅಷ್ಟಾವಕ್ರ ಒಪ್ಪಿ ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಕುಬೇರ ಅವನನ್ನು ಸತ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಕೈಲಾಸ-ಹಿಮಾಲಯದ ವೈಭವ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನಂತರ ಚಿನ್ನ-ರತ್ನಗಳ ಸುಂದರ ಆಶ್ರಮ ತಲುಪುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಮುದುಕಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಸ್ವಾಗತಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: अष्टावक्र सहमत होकर उत्तर जाते हैं जहाँ कुबेर उनका सत्कार करते हैं और वे कैलास तथा हिमालय का वैभव देखते हैं। फिर वे सोने-रत्नों के सुन्दर आश्रम पहुँचते हैं जहाँ एक वृद्धा उनका स्वागत करती है।
summary.te: అష్టావక్రుడు ఒప్పుకుని ఉత్తరానికి వెళ్తాడు, కుబేరుడు అతన్ని సత్కరిస్తాడు, కైలాసం, హిమాలయ వైభవం చూస్తాడు. తరువాత బంగారం, రత్నాల అందమైన ఆశ్రమం చేరగా అక్కడ ఒక ముసలి స్త్రీ అతన్ని స్వాగతిస్తుంది.
summary.ta: அஷ்டாவக்கிரர் ஒப்புக்கொண்டு வடக்கே செல்கிறார், குபேரன் அவரை உபசரிக்கிறான், கைலாசம் இமயத்தின் சிறப்புகளைக் காண்கிறார். பின் பொன்னும் மணியும் கொண்ட அழகிய ஆசிரமத்தை அடைகிறார், அங்கு ஒரு மூதாட்டி அவரை வரவேற்கிறாள்.
summary.ml: അഷ്ടാവക്രൻ സമ്മതിച്ച് വടക്കോട്ട് പോകുന്നു; അവിടെ കുബേരൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ആദരിക്കുന്നു, കൈലാസത്തിന്റെയും ഹിമാലയത്തിന്റെയും മഹിമ അദ്ദേഹം കാണുന്നു. പിന്നീട് സ്വർണ്ണവും രത്നങ്ങളും കൊണ്ടുള്ള മനോഹരമായ ഒരു ആശ്രമത്തിലെത്തുന്നു, അവിടെ ഒരു വൃദ്ധ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ സ്വാഗതം ചെയ്യുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.20; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: अष्टावक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Ashtavakra said:

verses.text:
तथास्तु साधयिष्यामि तत्र यास्याम्यसंशयम् ।
यत्र त्वं वदसे साधो भवान्भवतु सत्यवाक् ॥

meaning.en: So be it; I will accomplish it and surely go where you say. May you, good sir, be true to your word.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततोऽगच्छत्स भगवानुत्तरामुत्तमां दिशम् ।
हिमवन्तं गिरिश्रेष्ठं सिद्धचारणसेवितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed Ashtavakra went to the excellent northern direction, to the Himalaya, best of mountains, frequented by siddhas and charanas.

verses.text:
स गत्वा द्विजशार्दूलो हिमवन्तं महागिरिम् ।
अभ्यगच्छन्नदीं पुण्यां बाहुदां धर्मदायिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Having reached the great mountain Himalaya, the tiger among brahmins came to the holy river Bahuda, giver of merit.

verses.text:
अशोके विमले तीर्थे स्नात्वा तर्प्य च देवताः ।
तत्र वासाय शयने कौश्ये सुखमुवास ह ॥

meaning.en: He bathed at a stainless ford called Ashoka, offered water to the gods, and there slept comfortably for the night on a bed of kusha grass.

verses.text:
ततो रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां प्रातरुत्थाय स द्विजः ।
स्नात्वा प्रादुश्चकाराग्निं हुत्वा चैव विधानतः ॥

meaning.en: When the night had passed, that brahmin rose in the morning, bathed, lit the fire and made the offering according to the rule.

verses.text:
रुद्राणीकूपमासाद्य ह्रदे तत्र समाश्वसत् ।
विश्रान्तश्च समुत्थाय कैलासमभितो ययौ ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the Rudrani well, he rested by the pool there; refreshed, he rose and went toward Kailasa.

verses.text:
सोऽपश्यत्काञ्चनद्वारं दीप्यमानमिव श्रिया ।
मन्दाकिनीं च नलिनीं धनदस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: He saw a golden gate shining with splendor, and the Mandakini and the lotus pond of the great-souled giver of wealth.

verses.text:
अथ ते राक्षसाः सर्वे येऽभिरक्षन्ति पद्मिनीम् ।
प्रत्युत्थिता भगवन्तं मणिभद्रपुरोगमाः ॥

meaning.en: Then all the rakshasas who guard the lotus pond, led by Manibhadra, rose to meet the blessed sage.

verses.text:
स तान्प्रत्यर्चयामास राक्षसान्भीमविक्रमान् ।
निवेदयत मां क्षिप्रं धनदायेति चाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: He honored those rakshasas of terrible might and said, 'Quickly announce me to the giver of wealth.'

verses.text:
ते राक्षसास्तदा राजन्भगवन्तमथाब्रुवन् ।
असौ वैश्रवणो राजा स्वयमायाति तेऽन्तिकम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, king, those rakshasas said to the sage, 'King Vaishravana himself is coming to you.

verses.text:
विदितो भगवानस्य कार्यमागमने च यत् ।
पश्यैनं त्वं महाभागं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ॥

meaning.en: The Lord knows your errand in coming here. Look at this fortunate one who blazes with radiance.'

verses.text:
ततो वैश्रवणोऽभ्येत्य अष्टावक्रमनिन्दितम् ।
विधिवत्कुशलं पृष्ट्वा ततो ब्रह्मर्षिमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Vaishravana came up to the blameless Ashtavakra, asked after his welfare as is proper, and spoke to the brahmin sage.

verses.text:
सुखं प्राप्तो भवान्कच्चित्किं वा मत्तश्चिकीर्षसि ।
ब्रूहि सर्वं करिष्यामि यन्मां त्वं वक्ष्यसि द्विज ॥

meaning.en: He said, 'Have you arrived comfortably? What do you want from me? Tell me everything, brahmin; I will do whatever you ask.

verses.text:
भवनं प्रविश त्वं मे यथाकामं द्विजोत्तम ।
सत्कृतः कृतकार्यश्च भवान्यास्यत्यविघ्नतः ॥

meaning.en: Enter my house as you please, best of brahmins. Honored and with your task done, you will go on without obstacle.'

verses.text:
प्राविशद्भवनं स्वं वै गृहीत्वा तं द्विजोत्तमम् ।
आसनं स्वं ददौ चैव पाद्यमर्घ्यं तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: He took the best of brahmins into his house, gave him his own seat, and offered water for his feet and the guest-offering.

verses.text:
अथोपविष्टयोस्तत्र मणिभद्रपुरोगमाः ।
निषेदुस्तत्र कौबेरा यक्षगन्धर्वराक्षसाः ॥

meaning.en: When the two were seated there, the followers of Kubera, yakshas, gandharvas and rakshasas led by Manibhadra, sat down.

verses.text:
ततस्तेषां निषण्णानां धनदो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
भवच्छन्दं समाज्ञाय नृत्येरन्नप्सरोगणाः ॥

meaning.en: Then, when they were seated, the giver of wealth said, 'Knowing your wish, let the hosts of apsaras dance.

verses.text:
आतिथ्यं परमं कार्यं शुश्रूषा भवतस्तथा ।
संवर्ततामित्युवाच मुनिर्मधुरया गिरा ॥

meaning.en: Hospitality and service to you are my highest duty. Let it go on.' The sage answered in a sweet voice.

verses.text:
अथोर्वरा मिश्रकेशी रम्भा चैवोर्वशी तथा ।
अलम्बुसा घृताची च चित्रा चित्राङ्गदा रुचिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Urvara, Mishrakeshi, Rambha, Urvashi, Alambusa, Ghritachi, Chitra, Chitrangada and Ruchi,

verses.text:
मनोहरा सुकेशी च सुमुखी हासिनी प्रभा ।
विद्युता प्रशमा दान्ता विद्योता रतिरेव च ॥

meaning.en: Manohara, Sukeshi, Sumukhi, Hasini, Prabha, Vidyuta, Prashama, Danta, Vidyota and Rati,

verses.text:
एताश्चान्याश्च वै बह्व्यः प्रनृत्ताप्सरसः शुभाः ।
अवादयंश्च गन्धर्वा वाद्यानि विविधानि च ॥

meaning.en: these and many other lovely apsaras danced, and the gandharvas played instruments of many kinds.

verses.text:
अथ प्रवृत्ते गान्धर्वे दिव्ये ऋषिरुपावसत् ।
दिव्यं संवत्सरं तत्र रमन्वै सुमहातपाः ॥

meaning.en: When the divine music began, the sage stayed on there, delighting, a great ascetic, for a divine year.

verses.text:
ततो वैश्रवणो राजा भगवन्तमुवाच ह ।
साग्रः संवत्सरो यातस्तव विप्रेह पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Then King Vaishravana said to the sage, 'A full year has passed, brahmin, while you were here watching.

verses.text:
हार्योऽयं विषयो ब्रह्मन्गान्धर्वो नाम नामतः ।
छन्दतो वर्ततां विप्र यथा वदति वा भवान् ॥

meaning.en: This realm called the realm of gandharvas is captivating, brahmin. Let it continue as you like, or as you say.

verses.text:
अतिथिः पूजनीयस्त्वमिदं च भवतो गृहम् ।
सर्वमाज्ञाप्यतामाशु परवन्तो वयं त्वयि ॥

meaning.en: You are a guest to be honored, and this is your house. Give any order quickly; we are under your command.'

verses.text:
अथ वैश्रवणं प्रीतो भगवान्प्रत्यभाषत ।
अर्चितोऽस्मि यथान्यायं गमिष्यामि धनेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: Then the pleased sage replied to Vaishravana: 'I have been honored as is proper, lord of wealth; I will go.

verses.text:
प्रीतोऽस्मि सदृशं चैव तव सर्वं धनाधिप ।
तव प्रसादाद्भगवन्महर्षेश्च महात्मनः ।
नियोगादद्य यास्यामि वृद्धिमानृद्धिमान्भव ॥

meaning.en: I am pleased, and all this is worthy of you, lord of riches. By your grace, and by the great sage's order, I will go today. May you prosper and be wealthy.'

verses.text:
अथ निष्क्रम्य भगवान्प्रययावुत्तरामुखः ।
कैलासं मन्दरं हैमं सर्वाननुचचार ह ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed one left and went northward, passing Kailasa, Mandara and the Golden Mountain.

verses.text:
तानतीत्य महाशैलान्कैरातं स्थानमुत्तमम् ।
प्रदक्षिणं ततश्चक्रे प्रयतः शिरसा नमन् ।
धरणीमवतीर्याथ पूतात्मासौ तदाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Having passed those great mountains, he came to the excellent Kirata land and circled it clockwise with a bowed head, humbly; descending to the ground he became pure in soul.

verses.text:
स तं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा त्रिः शैलं चोत्तरामुखः ।
समेन भूमिभागेन ययौ प्रीतिपुरस्कृतः ॥

meaning.en: Having circled the mountain three times, facing north, he went on over level ground, led by gladness.

verses.text:
ततोऽपरं वनोद्देशं रमणीयमपश्यत ।
सर्वर्तुभिर्मूलफलैः पक्षिभिश्च समन्वितम् ।
रमणीयैर्वनोद्देशैस्तत्र तत्र विभूषितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then he saw another delightful stretch of forest, with fruits and roots of every season and with birds, adorned here and there with lovely forest spots.

verses.text:
तत्राश्रमपदं दिव्यं ददर्श भगवानथ ।
शैलांश्च विविधाकारान्काञ्चनान्रत्नभूषितान् ।
मणिभूमौ निविष्टाश्च पुष्करिण्यस्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: There the blessed one saw a divine hermitage, and many-shaped golden mountains adorned with jewels, and lotus ponds set on jeweled ground.

verses.text:
अन्यान्यपि सुरम्याणि ददर्श सुबहून्यथ ।
भृशं तस्य मनो रेमे महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: He saw many other beautiful things as well, and the mind of that sage of trained soul took great delight.

verses.text:
स तत्र काञ्चनं दिव्यं सर्वरत्नमयं गृहम् ।
ददर्शाद्भुतसंकाशं धनदस्य गृहाद्वरम् ॥

meaning.en: There he saw a divine house of gold, made wholly of jewels, wondrous in look and finer than the house of the giver of wealth.

verses.text:
महान्तो यत्र विविधाः प्रासादाः पर्वतोपमाः ।
विमानानि च रम्याणि रत्नानि विविधानि च ॥

meaning.en: It had great palaces like mountains, lovely celestial cars and jewels of many kinds.

verses.text:
मन्दारपुष्पैः संकीर्णा तथा मन्दाकिनी नदी ।
स्वयंप्रभाश्च मणयो वज्रैर्भूमिश्च भूषिता ॥

meaning.en: The Mandakini river was strewn with coral-tree flowers, the jewels shone by themselves, and the ground was adorned with diamonds.

verses.text:
नानाविधैश्च भवनैर्विचित्रमणितोरणैः ।
मुक्ताजालपरिक्षिप्तैर्मणिरत्नविभूषितैः ।
मनोदृष्टिहरै रम्यैः सर्वतः संवृतं शुभैः ॥

meaning.en: It was surrounded all around by lovely, lucky dwellings of many kinds, with gateways of wondrous gems, draped in pearl nets, adorned with jewels, and delightful to mind and eye.

verses.text:
ऋषिः समन्ततोऽपश्यत्तत्र तत्र मनोरमम् ।
ततोऽभवत्तस्य चिन्ता क्व मे वासो भवेदिति ॥

meaning.en: The sage saw delightful sights all around, and then he wondered, 'Where shall I stay?'

verses.text:
अथ द्वारं समभितो गत्वा स्थित्वा ततोऽब्रवीत् ।
अतिथिं मामनुप्राप्तमनुजानन्तु येऽत्र वै ॥

meaning.en: Then going to the gate and standing, he said, 'Let those who are here know that a guest has arrived.'

verses.text:
अथ कन्यापरिवृता गृहात्तस्माद्विनिःसृताः ।
नानारूपाः सप्त विभो कन्याः सर्वा मनोहराः ॥

meaning.en: Then seven young maidens of various forms, all captivating, came out of the house, surrounded by girls, lord.

verses.text:
यां यामपश्यत्कन्यां स सा सा तस्य मनोऽहरत् ।
नाशक्नुवद्धारयितुं मनोऽथास्यावसीदति ॥

meaning.en: Whichever maiden he looked at stole his mind away; he could not steady his mind, and it sank.

verses.text:
ततो धृतिः समुत्पन्ना तस्य विप्रस्य धीमतः ।
अथ तं प्रमदाः प्राहुर्भगवान्प्रविशत्विति ॥

meaning.en: Then steadiness arose in that wise brahmin. The girls said to him, 'Let the Blessed One enter.'

verses.text:
स च तासां सुरूपाणां तस्यैव भवनस्य च ।
कौतूहलसमाविष्टः प्रविवेश गृहं द्विजः ॥

meaning.en: Filled with curiosity about those beautiful women and that house, the brahmin entered the dwelling.

verses.text:
तत्रापश्यज्जरायुक्तामरजोम्बरधारिणीम् ।
वृद्धां पर्यङ्कमासीनां सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् ॥

meaning.en: There he saw an old woman, worn with age, wearing spotless clothing, seated on a couch and adorned with every ornament.

verses.text:
स्वस्तीति चाथ तेनोक्ता सा स्त्री प्रत्यवदत्तदा ।
प्रत्युत्थाय च तं विप्रमास्यतामित्युवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: When he said, 'May it be well,' the woman answered, rose to meet the brahmin, and said, 'Please sit.'

verses.text: अष्टावक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Ashtavakra said:

verses.text:
सर्वाः स्वानालयान्यान्तु एका मामुपतिष्ठतु ।
सुप्रज्ञाता सुप्रशान्ता शेषा गच्छन्तु च्छन्दतः ॥

meaning.en: 'Let all go to their own homes, and let one attend me, one who is wise and very calm; let the rest go as they please.'

verses.text:
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य कन्यास्तास्तमृषिं तदा ।
निराक्रामन्गृहात्तस्मात्सा वृद्धाथ व्यतिष्ठत ॥

meaning.en: Then the girls circled the sage clockwise and left the house, and the old woman remained.

verses.text:
अथ तां संविशन्प्राह शयने भास्वरे तदा ।
त्वयापि सुप्यतां भद्रे रजनी ह्यतिवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: Then, as he lay down on a shining bed, he said to her, 'You too should sleep, good lady; the night is passing.'

verses.text:
संलापात्तेन विप्रेण तथा सा तत्र भाषिता ।
द्वितीये शयने दिव्ये संविवेश महाप्रभे ॥

meaning.en: Spoken to thus in conversation by the brahmin, she lay down on a second divine and splendid bed.

verses.text:
अथ सा वेपमानाङ्गी निमित्तं शीतजं तदा ।
व्यपदिश्य महर्षेर्वै शयनं चाध्यरोहत ॥

meaning.en: Then, her limbs trembling and giving the cold as the reason, she climbed onto the great sage's bed.

verses.text:
स्वागतं स्वागतेनास्तु भगवांस्तामभाषत ।
सोपागूहद्भुजाभ्यां तु ऋषिं प्रीत्या नरर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: 'Welcome, welcome,' the blessed one said to her. And, best of men, she embraced the sage with love in her arms.

verses.text:
निर्विकारमृषिं चापि काष्ठकुड्योपमं तदा ।
दुःखिता प्रेक्ष्य संजल्पमकार्षीदृषिणा सह ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the sage unmoved, like a wooden wall, she was distressed and spoke to the sage.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मन्न कामकारोऽस्ति स्त्रीणां पुरुषतो धृतिः ।
कामेन मोहिता चाहं त्वां भजन्तीं भजस्व माम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Brahmin, women have no freedom of desire and no firmness before a man. I am bewildered by desire; you should accept me who am coming to you.

verses.text:
प्रहृष्टो भव विप्रर्षे समागच्छ मया सह ।
उपगूह च मां विप्र कामार्ताहं भृशं त्वयि ॥

meaning.en: Be glad, sage-brahmin, come together with me. Embrace me, brahmin; I am sorely stricken with desire for you.

verses.text:
एतद्धि तव धर्मात्मंस्तपसः पूज्यते फलम् ।
प्रार्थितं दर्शनादेव भजमानां भजस्व माम् ॥

meaning.en: Righteous one, this is the honored fruit of your austerity: I was longed for at a glance. Take me who have turned to you.

verses.text:
सद्म चेदं वनं चेदं यच्चान्यदपि पश्यसि ।
प्रभुत्वं तव सर्वत्र मयि चैव न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: This house, this forest and anything else you see: your lordship is over everything, and over me, without doubt.

verses.text:
सर्वान्कामान्विधास्यामि रमस्व सहितो मया ।
रमणीये वने विप्र सर्वकामफलप्रदे ॥

meaning.en: I will fulfill all your wishes. Take your pleasure with me in this delightful forest which grants every desire, brahmin.

verses.text:
त्वद्वशाहं भविष्यामि रंस्यसे च मया सह ।
सर्वान्कामानुपाश्नानो ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः ॥

meaning.en: I will be at your command and you will enjoy yourself with me, tasting every desire, divine and human.

verses.text:
नातः परं हि नारीणां कार्यं किंचन विद्यते ।
यथा पुरुषसंसर्गः परमेतद्धि नः फलम् ॥

meaning.en: There is nothing more for women to do than this: union with a man is for us the highest fruit.

verses.text:
आत्मच्छन्देन वर्तन्ते नार्यो मन्मथचोदिताः ।
न च दह्यन्ति गच्छन्त्यः सुतप्तैरपि पांसुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Women move at their own will, driven by love, and they are not burnt even while walking on well-heated dust.'

verses.text: अष्टावक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Ashtavakra said:

verses.text:
परदारानहं भद्रे न गच्छेयं कथंचन ।
दूषितं धर्मशास्त्रेषु परदाराभिमर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Good lady, I would never go to another man's wife. Touching another's wife is condemned in the dharma treatises.

verses.text:
भद्रे निवेष्टुकामं मां विद्धि सत्येन वै शपे ।
विषयेष्वनभिज्ञोऽहं धर्मार्थं किल संततिः ॥

meaning.en: Know, good lady, that I wish to marry, and I swear it truly. I am ignorant of pleasures; offspring is indeed for the sake of dharma.

verses.text:
एवं लोकान्गमिष्यामि पुत्रैरिति न संशयः ।
भद्रे धर्मं विजानीष्व ज्ञात्वा चोपरमस्व ह ॥

meaning.en: By sons I shall thus reach the worlds, without doubt. Know dharma, good lady, and knowing it, desist.'

verses.text: स्त्र्युवाच

meaning.en: The woman said:

verses.text:
नानिलोऽग्निर्न वरुणो न चान्ये त्रिदशा द्विज ।
प्रियाः स्त्रीणां यथा कामो रतिशीला हि योषितः ॥

meaning.en: 'Neither wind, nor fire, nor Varuna, nor any other god is as dear to women as desire; women delight in love.

verses.text:
सहस्रैका यता नारी प्राप्नोतीह कदाचन ।
तथा शतसहस्रेषु यदि काचित्पतिव्रता ॥

meaning.en: One woman in a thousand may perhaps be found here who is restrained, and among hundreds of thousands, if any, one faithful to her husband.

verses.text:
नैता जानन्ति पितरं न कुलं न च मातरम् ।
न भ्रातॄन्न च भर्तारं न पुत्रान्न च देवरान् ॥

meaning.en: They do not know a father, a family, a mother, brothers, a husband, sons or brothers-in-law.

verses.text:
लीलायन्त्यः कुलं घ्नन्ति कूलानीव सरिद्वराः ।
दोषांश्च मन्दान्मन्दासु प्रजापतिरभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Playing, they destroy a family as great rivers break their banks. Prajapati spoke of such faults in the weak-minded women.'

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततः स ऋषिरेकाग्रस्तां स्त्रियं प्रत्यभाषत ।
आस्यतां रुचिरं छन्दः किं वा कार्यं ब्रवीहि मे ॥

meaning.en: Then the sage, with a steady mind, answered her: 'Sit as you wish; or tell me what you need.'

verses.text:
सा स्त्री प्रोवाच भगवन्द्रक्ष्यसे देशकालतः ।
वस तावन्महाप्राज्ञ कृतकृत्यो गमिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: The woman said, 'Blessed one, you will see in due place and time. Stay for now, wise one; you will leave with your task done.'

verses.text:
ब्रह्मर्षिस्तामथोवाच स तथेति युधिष्ठिर ।
वत्स्येऽहं यावदुत्साहो भवत्या नात्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: The brahmin sage said to her, 'So be it,' Yudhishthira. 'I will stay as long as you wish; there is no doubt.'

verses.text:
अथर्षिरभिसंप्रेक्ष्य स्त्रियं तां जरयान्विताम् ।
चिन्तां परमिकां भेजे संतप्त इव चाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, looking at that woman weighed down by age, the sage fell into deep worry and seemed tormented.

verses.text:
यद्यदङ्गं हि सोऽपश्यत्तस्या विप्रर्षभस्तदा ।
नारमत्तत्र तत्रास्य दृष्टी रूपपराजिता ॥

meaning.en: Whichever of her limbs that best of brahmins looked at, his eyes found no pleasure there, defeated by her appearance.

verses.text:
देवतेयं गृहस्यास्य शापान्नूनं विरूपिता ।
अस्याश्च कारणं वेत्तुं न युक्तं सहसा मया ॥

meaning.en: He thought, 'This is surely a goddess of this house, disfigured by a curse. It is not proper for me to ask the cause of this suddenly.'

verses.text:
इति चिन्ताविषक्तस्य तमर्थं ज्ञातुमिच्छतः ।
व्यगमत्तदहःशेषं मनसा व्याकुलेन तु ॥

meaning.en: As he was lost in such thought, wishing to know the matter, the rest of that day passed with his mind in turmoil.

verses.text:
अथ सा स्त्री तदोवाच भगवन्पश्य वै रवेः ।
रूपं संध्याभ्रसंयुक्तं किमुपस्थाप्यतां तव ॥

meaning.en: Then the woman said, 'Blessed one, look at the sun's form joined with evening clouds; what shall be provided for you?'

verses.text:
स उवाच तदा तां स्त्रीं स्नानोदकमिहानय ।
उपासिष्ये ततः संध्यां वाग्यतो नियतेन्द्रियः ॥

meaning.en: He then said to her, 'Bring water for bathing here. Then I will perform the evening worship, silent and with senses restrained.'
